name: Speed
note: Quick Control 1 (D8). 0.5 = no change. The id is target-neutral: D8/A2 let a macro be pointed somewhere else later without a new id; until then the name is the D8 label, and once reassignment exists the name follows the target (updateHostDisplay with parameterInfoChanged).

name: Volume Offset
note: PROMPT 8.3 id kept (same meaning). Added to the amp lane value of every voice, clip and live, then clamped 0..1.

name: Vibrato Offset
note: PROMPT 8.3 id kept (same meaning). Added to the vib lane value of every voice, clip and live, then clamped 0..1.

name: Tone Offset
note: PROMPT 8.3 id kept (same meaning). Added to the tone lane value of every voice, clip and live, then clamped 0..1.

name: Formant Offset
note: PROMPT 8.3 id kept (same meaning). Added to the formant lane value of every voice, clip and live, then clamped 0..1.

name: Hollow Offset
note: PROMPT 8.3 id kept (same meaning). Added to the hollow lane value of every voice, clip and live, then clamped 0..1.

name: Output Gain
note: PROMPT 8.3 id kept. Range = SLModel.normalizeInst (-60..+12 dB). The 20 ms ramp is interpolated per sample in the output loop (plan 2.3).

name: Engine
note: PROMPT 8.3 id kept; choices are now Tape/Voice/Cloud (D1). The engine of every note whose own engine is null ("follow", D6). Frozen at 3 choices.

name: Lock
note: Cloud only (GrainLock's trick). Ignored by Tape and Voice notes.

name: Motion
note: The Motion of notes whose own Motion is null. Tape plays Freeze as Forward.

name: Sample Speed
note: Range = SLModel.normalizeInst (0..16). The Sample tab knob shows 1/8x..8x on a log scale and accepts 0..16 typed.

name: Sample Heads
note: Fractional (D3): 2.5 = two full heads plus a third at half level.

name: Sample Spread
note: Head start offsets i/H*spread of the Region and pan +-(spread*0.75).

name: Voice Grain
note: Cycles of the sample root (Voice engine).

name: Cloud Grain
note: Milliseconds (Cloud engine, Lock off).

name: Lock Grain
note: Wavelengths of the played note (Cloud + Lock). The engine caps the taps at LOCK_MAX_N = 12 after the Grain lane and macro.

name: Sample Spray
note: Seeded scatter of each grab: spray x min(1 s, Region/2). Applies to new grains only.

name: Drift
note: Each head runs at x(1 + drift*0.25*r), r seeded per head from the chain's first note.

name: Pitch
note: Transposes the whole instrument. Not touched by sound presets, recipes or Dice.

name: Tape
note: Voice and Cloud grains read faster or slower with the heads. The Tape setting of notes whose own Tape is null.

name: Each Grain Backwards
note: The setting of notes whose own one is null.

name: Jump Every
note: Scatter's jump rate, locked to the song beat. The rate of notes whose own Jump is null. Rates are quarter-note beats (BLUEPRINT 1.5): "1 bar" is 4 beats whatever the clip's beatsPerBar; StrandLock's own UI reads it as "4 beats" when beatsPerBar is not 4.

name: Refresh Mode
note: Order = SLModel.REFRESH_MODES (smooth, free, sync).

name: Refresh Time
note: Free Refresh period, before the Refresh lane and macro scale it.

name: Refresh Every
note: Synced Refresh period. Rates are quarter-note beats (BLUEPRINT 1.5): "1 bar" is 4 beats whatever the clip's beatsPerBar; StrandLock's own UI reads it as "4 beats" when beatsPerBar is not 4.

name: Refresh Lock to Beat
note: Synced Refresh takes its phase from the song beat (off = counts from each voice's start).

name: Refresh Skip
note: Seeded chance a refresh is skipped (the same every loop until Re-roll).

name: Region Start
display: percent of the file, plus m:ss.ss when a sample is loaded
note: Replaces PROMPT startOffset (different meaning, so a new id). A fraction of the loaded range (the whole file, or the part loaded from a long file). Start > end is swapped (as normalizeInst). StrandLock keeps the exact f64 edge it set in INST and plays it while this float still equals it (plan 2.2), so float32 never moves a beat loop by a frame.

name: Region End
display: percent of the file, plus m:ss.ss when a sample is loaded
note: A fraction of the loaded range. The engine keeps the Region at least 64 frames long. Exact f64 edge in INST, as regionStart.

name: At the End
note: Replaces PROMPT sustainLoop (different meaning, so a new id).

name: Loop Crossfade
note: PROMPT 8.3 id kept (same meaning). The engine caps it at a quarter of the Region.

name: Auto Slide
note: PROMPT 8.3 id kept. The snapshot carries glides and chains for all three modes, so automating it needs no recompile.

name: Slide Time
display: rate name when rateFromBeats finds one within 1%, else beats with 3 decimals
note: PROMPT 8.3 id kept, now a continuous beat value (a choice list would have to grow). Used by notes whose own glide is null; each glide is capped at 95% of its note.

name: Vibrato Speed
note: PROMPT 8.3 id kept. The vibrato phase is continuous through any change, so no smoothing.

name: Vibrato Sync
note: PROMPT 8.3 id kept. Not in prototype v4 (Free = the prototype). Synced: vibrato frequency = (bpm/60)/rateBeats; the phase stays per voice. Rates are quarter-note beats (BLUEPRINT 1.5): "1 bar" is 4 beats whatever the clip's beatsPerBar; StrandLock's own UI reads it as "4 beats" when beatsPerBar is not 4.

name: Bend Range
note: PROMPT 8.3 id kept. Pitch bend +-bendRange on live voices; Rec writes bends with it.

name: Velocity Sensitivity
note: PROMPT 8.3 id kept. Gain = 1 - velSens*(1 - vel), clip and live notes alike.

name: Voices
note: PROMPT 8.3 id kept, range 1..32 as both prototype modules. Applies at the next note start (oldest stolen with a 5 ms fade).

name: Live Legato
note: F4: a new key while another is held takes over its voice and playhead.

name: Root Note
note: PROMPT 8.3 id kept. Belongs to the loaded sound (v4, sl-ui.js): a sound load (60 for a starter) and Detect or an accepted root suggestion set it without an undo step; Undo of a sound change brings that sound back with its own root.

name: Root Cents
note: PROMPT 8.3 id kept. Root pitch = rootNote + rootCents/100. Belongs to the loaded sound, like rootNote (not an undo step).

name: Bypass
note: Returned by getBypassParameter(). The output fades to silence over 20 ms (per-sample gain ramp) while voices keep running. Never in presets, resets or undo.
